conditions: Housing Code eligibility gate — this is a separate Complying Development Certificate (CDC) pathway to the standard DA process; strict eligibility, no discretion/variation available.
source_text: Complying development under the Housing Code may only be carried out on a lot with an area of at least 200m2.
The width of the lot must be at least 6m measured at the building line.
On a battle-axe lot, the lot (not including the access laneway) must be at least 12m by 12m, with an access laneway at least 3m wide.
On a corner lot, the primary road boundary of the lot must be at least 6m wide.
A basement with an area exceeding this limit is NOT complying development under this code (falls back to a standard DA). Lot width 6-10m: 25m2 max.
A basement with an area exceeding this limit is NOT complying development under this code (falls back to a standard DA). Lot width >10m: 45m2 max.
Maximum height for a dwelling house and any attached development is 8.5m above ground level (existing).
Maximum gross floor area of all buildings on the lot, lot area 200m2-250m2: 78% of lot area.
Maximum gross floor area of all buildings on the lot, lot area >250m2-300m2: 75% of lot area.
Maximum gross floor area of all buildings on the lot, lot area >300m2-350m2: 235m2 (fixed cap).
Maximum gross floor area of all buildings on the lot, lot area >450m2-560m2: 290m2 (fixed cap).
Maximum gross floor area of all buildings on the lot, lot area >600m2-740m2: 335m2 (fixed cap).
Maximum gross floor area of all buildings on the lot, lot area >900m2-920m2: 380m2 (fixed cap).
Maximum gross floor area of all buildings on the lot, lot area >1,000m2: 400m2 (fixed cap).

conditions: Reference only — formula-based tiers of the max GFA table, see source_text
source_text: For lot areas of >350-450m2, >560-600m2, >740-900m2 and >920-1,000m2, maximum GFA is 25% of lot area + 150m2 (not a single fixed number — apply the formula to the actual lot area).

conditions: No 2 comparable dwellings within 40m; lot size 200-300m2. Otherwise the setback is the average of the 2 nearest dwelling houses on the same side of the road (s.3.10(1)).
source_text: If there are not 2 dwelling houses within 40m on the same side of the primary road, minimum setback from the primary road for lot size 200-300m2: 3m.

conditions: No 2 comparable dwellings within 40m; lot size >300m2-900m2
source_text: Minimum setback from primary road (no 2 comparable dwellings within 40m), lot size >300m2-900m2: 4.5m.

conditions: No 2 comparable dwellings within 40m; lot size >900m2-1,500m2
source_text: Minimum setback from primary road (no 2 comparable dwellings within 40m), lot size >900m2-1,500m2: 6.5m.

conditions: No 2 comparable dwellings within 40m; lot size >1,500m2
source_text: Minimum setback from primary road (no 2 comparable dwellings within 40m), lot size >1,500m2: 10m.

conditions: Lot width 6-10m (height 0-5.5m) or >10-18m (height 0-4.5m); formula applies at greater heights: (height - break height) / 4 + 0.9m
source_text: Minimum side boundary setback for a dwelling house, carport/garage, balcony/deck/patio/pergola/terrace/verandah, or cabana/cubby/shed: lot width 6-10m at building height 0-5.5m, or lot width >10-18m at building height 0-4.5m: 900mm. Above these heights the setback increases per a stated formula — see source_text.
Minimum side boundary setback: lot width >18-24m at building height 0-4.5m: 1.5m. Above 4.5m the setback increases per formula (height-4.5m)/4 + 1.5m.
Minimum side boundary setback: lot width >24m, any height up to 8.5m: 2.5m (flat, no formula increase at this width tier).
Maximum height of a wall built within 900mm of a side boundary is 3.3m above ground level (existing), unless a higher wall already exists on the adjoining lot (capped at 8.5m).
Maximum length of walls within 900mm of a side boundary, lot width 6-10m: 20m or 50% of lot depth, whichever is lesser.
Maximum length of walls within 900mm of a side boundary, lot width >10-12.5m: 10m.
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area 200-300m2, building height 0-4.5m: 3m.
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area 200-300m2, building height >4.5-8.5m: 10m (or the average rear setback of the 2 adjoining dwelling houses at 4.5m height, whichever is lesser).
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area >300-900m2, building height 0-4.5m: 3m.
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area >300-900m2, building height >4.5-8.5m: 8m.
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area >900-1,500m2, building height 0-4.5m: 5m.
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area >900-1,500m2, building height >4.5-8.5m: 12m.
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area >1,500m2, building height 0-4.5m: 10m.
Minimum rear boundary setback, lot area >1,500m2, building height >4.5-8.5m: 15m.
Minimum setback from a secondary road (corner lots), lot size 200-600m2: 2m.
Minimum setback from a secondary road (corner lots), lot size >600-1,500m2: 3m.
Minimum setback from a secondary road (corner lots), lot size >1,500m2: 5m.
Minimum setback from a parallel road for a dwelling house and any attached development is 3m.
Minimum setback from a classified road is 9m, unless another environmental planning instrument specifies a different figure for the land.
Minimum setback from a public reserve boundary for a dwelling house or ancillary cabana/shed/gazebo/studio is 3m.
On a battle-axe lot, minimum setback from the rear boundary in front of the battle-axe lot is 3m.

conditions: <3m from side/rear boundary; lot area >300m2, lot width >10m
source_text: Maximum floor level above ground level (existing) for a side/rear attached balcony, deck, patio, terrace or verandah, <3m from side/rear boundary: 2m. Only permitted where lot area >300m2 and lot width >10m.

conditions: 3-6m from side/rear boundary; lot area >300m2, lot width >10m
source_text: Maximum floor level above ground level (existing) for a side/rear attached balcony, deck, patio, terrace or verandah, 3-6m from side/rear boundary: 3m. Only permitted where lot area >300m2 and lot width >10m.

conditions: >6m from side/rear boundary; lot area >300m2, lot width >10m
source_text: Maximum floor level above ground level (existing) for a side/rear attached balcony, deck, patio, terrace or verandah, >6m from side/rear boundary: 4m. Only permitted where lot area >300m2 and lot width >10m.

Maximum total floor area of attached side/rear balconies, decks, patios, terraces and verandahs within 6m of a side/rear boundary with a finished floor level of more than 2m above ground level (existing): 12m2.
Minimum landscaped area, lot area 200-300m2: 10% of lot area.
Minimum landscaped area, lot area >300-450m2: 15% of lot area.
Minimum landscaped area, lot area >450-600m2: 20% of lot area.
Minimum landscaped area, lot area >600-900m2: 30% of lot area.
Minimum landscaped area, lot area >900-1,500m2: 40% of lot area.
Minimum landscaped area, lot area >1,500m2: 45% of lot area.
Each landscaped area must have a minimum width and length of 1.5m.
Minimum principal private open space, lot width (at building line) 6-10m: 16m2.
Minimum principal private open space, lot width (at building line) >10m: 24m2.
Principal private open space must be at least 3m wide and 3m long, and no steeper than 1:50 gradient.
A dwelling house with a primary road setback of at least 3m may have an articulation zone extending up to 1.5m forward of the minimum required setback.
Maximum total area of building elements in the articulation zone (other than awnings/sun shading/eaves): 25% of the articulation zone area.
A dwelling house on a corner lot must have a habitable room window of at least 1m2 facing and visible from the secondary road.

A dwelling house with a secondary road setback of not more than 4.5m must have an articulating building element (entry feature, balcony, bay window, or 600mm step) for at least 20% of the length of the walls facing and within 4.5m of the secondary road.

conditions: Bedroom windows of 2m2 or less are exempt
source_text: A privacy screen is required for a habitable room window less than 1.5m above finished floor level if the window faces and is less than 3m from a side/rear boundary and the room floor is more than 1m above ground level (existing). (Extends to 3-6m from boundary if floor is more than 3m above ground level.)

A privacy screen on a balcony/deck/patio/terrace/verandah must be between 1.7m and 2.2m above the finished floor level, at the edge facing the side/rear boundary, if the balcony area is at least 3m2 and floor level thresholds in s.3.15(3)(a)/(b) are met.

At least 1 off-street car parking space must be provided on the lot, unless the lot is less than 8m wide at the building line, or the development is an alteration/addition and no existing off-street space exists.
An attached garage on a lot narrower than 8m at the building line may only be accessed from a secondary road, parallel road or lane.
Minimum setback of an attached garage/carport/car space accessed from a primary road, where the dwelling house setback from that road is less than 4.5m: 5.5m.
Maximum width of all garage door openings facing a primary/secondary/parallel road, lot width 8-12m: 3.2m.
Maximum width of all garage door openings facing a primary/secondary/parallel road, lot width >12m: 6m.
Maximum height for detached development (other than swimming pools/fences) is 4.5m above ground level (existing).
Maximum gross floor area of a detached deck/patio/pergola/terrace/verandah, cabana/shed/gazebo/greenhouse, carport/garage or shed, lot size 200-300m2: 36m2.
Maximum gross floor area of a detached deck/patio/pergola/terrace/verandah, cabana/shed/gazebo/greenhouse, carport/garage or shed, lot size >300-600m2: 45m2.
Maximum gross floor area of a detached deck/patio/pergola/terrace/verandah, cabana/shed/gazebo/greenhouse, carport/garage or shed, lot size >600-900m2: 60m2.
Maximum gross floor area of a detached deck/patio/pergola/terrace/verandah, cabana/shed/gazebo/greenhouse, carport/garage or shed, lot size >900m2: 100m2.
Minimum side boundary setback for detached development (deck/patio/pergola/etc, cabana/shed, carport/garage, above-ground rainwater tank, shade structure/shed), lot width 6-18m: 0.9m.
Minimum side boundary setback for detached development (deck/patio/pergola/etc, cabana/shed, carport/garage, above-ground rainwater tank, shade structure/shed), lot width >18-24m: 1.5m.
Minimum side boundary setback for detached development (deck/patio/pergola/etc, cabana/shed, carport/garage, above-ground rainwater tank, shade structure/shed), lot width >24m: 2.5m.
Maximum height of a detached-development wall within 900mm of a side boundary: 3.3m (capped at 4.5m if matching an existing adjoining wall).
Minimum rear boundary setback for cabana/shed/gazebo/greenhouse, above-ground rainwater tank, or shade structure/shed, lot area 200-900m2: 0.9m.
Minimum rear boundary setback for cabana/shed/gazebo/greenhouse, above-ground rainwater tank, or shade structure/shed, lot area >900-1,500m2: 1.5m.
Minimum rear boundary setback for cabana/shed/gazebo/greenhouse, above-ground rainwater tank, or shade structure/shed, lot area >1,500m2: 2.5m.
Minimum setback from a parallel road for detached development is 3m.
Minimum rear boundary setback for a detached garage or carport, lot area 200-900m2: 0.9m.
Minimum rear boundary setback for a detached garage or carport, lot area >900-1,500m2: 1.5m.
Minimum rear boundary setback for a detached garage or carport, lot area >1,500m2: 2.5m.
Minimum setback of a detached garage/carport on a corner lot from the secondary road, lot size 200-600m2: 2m.
Minimum setback of a detached garage/carport on a corner lot from the secondary road, lot size >600-1,500m2: 3m.
Minimum setback of a detached garage/carport on a corner lot from the secondary road, lot size >1,500m2: 5m.
Maximum finished floor level for a detached deck, patio, pergola, terrace or verandah is 600mm above ground level (existing).
Maximum gross floor area of a detached studio, lot size 200-350m2: 20m2 (limited to 1 studio per lot).
Maximum gross floor area of a detached studio, lot size >350m2: 36m2 (limited to 1 studio per lot).
Minimum side/rear boundary setback for a detached studio, lot width 6-18m: 0.9m.
Minimum side/rear boundary setback for a detached studio, lot width >18m: 1.5m.

conditions: Studio within 900mm of a lane, above a garage
source_text: A detached studio within 900mm of a lane and above a garage may be up to 6m above ground level (existing) (overrides the general 4.5m detached development height limit).
Maximum height of pool coping above ground level (existing) is 1.4m (max 300mm wide if coping is more than 600mm high).
Maximum height of decking around a swimming pool above ground level (existing) is 600mm.
Minimum setback of the swimming pool water line from a side or rear boundary is 1m.
A swimming pool pump must be in a soundproofed enclosure located more than 450mm from each lot boundary.
Maximum height of a fence behind the building line is 1.8m above ground level (existing) (2.2m at each step on a sloping/stepped site).
Maximum height of a fence forward of the building line is 1.2m above ground level (existing); must be at least 20% open above 400mm height.
Maximum excavation depth from ground level (existing), within 1m of any boundary: 1m.
Maximum excavation depth from ground level (existing), >1-1.5m from any boundary: 2m.
Maximum excavation depth from ground level (existing), >1.5m from any boundary: 3m.
Maximum excavation depth is capped at 1m regardless of boundary distance if the land is Class 3/4 Acid Sulfate Soils or within 40m of a natural waterbody.
Maximum fill height for a dwelling house is 1m above ground level (existing) (no limit if wholly within the building footprint or contained by a drop-edge beam).
Maximum fill height for any other complying development under this code is 600mm above ground level (existing).
A retaining wall/structural support must be separated from any other retaining wall/structural support on the site by at least 2m (measured horizontally).
Earthworks more than 600mm above or below ground level (existing) require an engineer-certified retaining wall or structural support.
Development under this code must be at least 3m from each protected tree on the lot and on an adjoining lot (measured from the base of the trunk).
